ai_briefing.morning_summary: Major cryptocurrencies posted modest gains on Tuesday, with Bitcoin up 1% to $84,838 and ETH up 0.7%, while bond yields retreated from 24‑year highs, supporting the local uptrend. Regulatory headlines are mixed, as Illinois delays its contentious crypto tax and New York and Wyoming announce a coordination pact, while a recent NEAR exploit adds security risk. New listings on Delta India (QNT, ARK, MOVR, SOON, BTW) provide fresh trading opportunities.
